messages.text: Thursday, September 24 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn's first crisp air, jazz notes, and a town's future
A mostly clear Thursday arrives with crisp autumn air and a high near 70°F. Look for jazz performances in Ann Arbor and discussions on Ann Arbor's downtown property sale.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 51°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:24 AM and sunset is at 7:27 PM, with the moon appearing as a waxing gibbous, 93.4% illuminated.
Ann Arbor's evening sounds and sights
For a taste of jazz, consider Fresh Berrys. at El Limon at 6:00 PM, or Pianist Barron Ryan at Kerrytown Concert House at 7:30 PM.
Evil Gigawatt's birthday is today, September 24.
Ann Arbor plans for downtown property sale funds
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the $14.2 million to $17.4 million expected from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Friday brings film and music
Tomorrow, catch a free outdoor screening of 'Best in Show' at Campus Martius Park in Detroit, or attend Dolly Day at the Ann Arbor District Library.
Satellites navigate without GPS, new cancer treatment advances

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to advance non-invasive cancer treatments using soundwaves.
The Starship launch schedule is unset, with no official date listed for its next attempt.
A clear sky offers many paths to discovery.
Friday, September 25 · Canton, Michigan
Full Moon Rises Over Overcast Skies, Music Fills the Air
An overcast but mild Friday offers a variety of local music and arts events across the region. The most consequential local news involves Ann Arbor's plans for downtown property sale funds.
Today will be overcast with a high near 70°F and a low around 48°F.
Sunrise is at 7:25 AM, sunset at 7:26 PM, with a full moon 97.6% illuminated.
Evening Arts and Music Across the Region
The Ann Arbor District Library hosts Dolly Day with crafts and concert videos starting at 5:30 PM. For music lovers, the Dossin Great Lakes Museum offers jazz and cocktails starting at 6 PM.
Tomorrow, the Big Read kicks off in Ypsilanti with performances and book giveaways.
Ann Arbor's Plan for Downtown Property Sale Funds
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the expected $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Tomorrow Offers Music and Community Events
Tomorrow, catch the Big Read kickoff in Ypsilanti at 11 AM or a free performance of Mariposa/Butterfly at 2 PM. For music, The Ark features Devon Gilfillian at 8 PM.
Autonomous Satellite Navigation and Lunar Landing Tests

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras. NASA has also begun flight-relevant lunar landing plume tests to measure crater formation and ejecta.
The next Starship launch estimate is not yet available.
Seek out an experience that sparks curiosity, then give it your full attention.
